description: Use this when the user wants 2-4 US power grids (ISOs) side by side, e.g. "PJM,ERCOT": fuel mix, demand, renewable and gas share, queue depth, time to power.

isos.description: Comma-separated list of 2-4 US ISO/RTO grid regions to compare, e.g. "PJM,ERCOT,CAISO" (valid: ERCOT, PJM, MISO, CAISO, SPP, NYISO, ISONE)

name: compare_isos
title: Compare ISO Regions
